mission.title: Programs in Peril
mission.description: Free a kidnapped hardline maintenance program from the Exiles.

npc.say: Take that program to Agent Stewart.
An "LED" is a "Light-Emitting Diode," but those imposter agents are dim bulbs!
Where do those imposter Agents keep coming from? There's got to be some way to track them.
Exiles, Agent imposters... What's next? Things have been getting kind of weird lately.

phase.briefing: Some of our maintenance programs who specialize in hardline junction box repair have been kidnapped. We have traced the signal of one of them to a building in your vicinity. Free the program and demolish the kidnappers.

enter.say: The hardline maintenance program Long The Mechanic's signal has been traced to that building. Bring him out of the area. Eradicate anyone who tries to stop you.

done.say: Hacking that computer seems to have enabled a door access somewhere nearby.
Scanners are detecting a computer with security access in that room.
There is a security system terminal in that room. It seems that the security system in that location is rather Byzantine.
You've used that computer to enable access to a security door nearby. Good thinking.
You should find another security system terminal in that room.
A door nearby has been unlocked.
Exiles... phaw. They should know better than to meddle in Machine affairs.

talk.say: You have located our maintenance program, Long The Mechanic. Effectuate his removal from the premises.
Wow, I didn't think that anyone would be able to get through their security system. Let's get out of here!

objective.text: Lead Long The Mechanic out of the area

talk.say: Let's get out of here before the door locks recycle.

phase.briefing: Good. Now you will take Long The Mechanic to our secure operation center nearby. Follow the waypoint.

enter.say: Our operation center is in that building. Present Long The Mechanic to our program Agent Stewart for debriefing.

objective.text: Bring Long The Mechanic to Agent Stewart

talk.say: Aren't you supposed to take me somewhere safe?

done.say: You have achieved safe delivery of the maintenance program. You may exit the area now.

complete.say: Thank you! You are now my very favorite human.

mission.finish: You have successfully restored our maintenance program, {player}. It is unclear what the Exiles meant to do with him, but perhaps they have ambitions of taking over a section of our hardline network. We shall have to watch them closely.
